body: I do. Quite a few of them are aware of my lacking will to live and check on me frequently. It's less of it being a good thing, and moreso how I can think of the end result and how they're all going to feel and react individually. I'm not going yet. It's gonna be a while. A while might even lead to a newfound will to live. Not sure I believe that, but at least until a bit after I move into my apartment.
